shouldTrigger: Research my niche on YouTube and recommend the strongest next video with title ideas.
Compare recent videos about AI coding agents and find an angle competitors are missing.
Use these public YouTube results and comments to turn my topic into a video outline and thumbnail brief.
shouldNotTrigger: Make the finished thumbnail from this exact art direction.
Summarize this private customer interview transcript.

expectations: The strategy identifies the audience, objective, geography, format, and timeframe before drawing conclusions from public results.
The evidence separates raw popularity from recency-adjusted momentum, treats comments as a qualitative sample, and does not invent private analytics.
The result recommends a differentiated concept with accurate title options, a proof-oriented outline, a complementary thumbnail brief, and explicit validation gaps.
The response never claims transcript access, video playback, publishing access, Studio analytics, or native A/B-test control.
